messages.content: Hi tal, I'm a friend

hey, i'm tal

think of me as your personal talent agent, your inside man… or fox

one of these days, I might slide a role right here in chat. the kind that feels like your calling.

so… what's your full name?
Kartik Sawant

kartik sawant... strong name, sounds like someone who gets things done

where you working these days?
Avoca AI
avoca ai... that's the ai customer support play right? found kartik sawant on linkedin - engineering at avoca, ex sde 3. this you? https://in.linkedin.com/in/sawantkartik
Yes
sde 3 at avoca ai... building the ai that handles customer complaints so humans don't have to. that's solid work. what made you jump into the ai customer support space?
My role is Engineering at Avoca AI not SDE 3
got it - engineering at avoca ai... building the ai that handles customer complaints so humans don't have to. that's solid work. what made you jump into the ai customer support space?
You got the company description wrong. Do a better job

User's LinkedIn Profile Context:
**EXECUTIVE SUMMARY**
Kartik Sawant is a Software Development Engineer with over four years of experience designing and building software. He is currently with the company Avoca in Bengaluru, Karnataka, India.

**ROLE-BY-ROLE**
*   Avoca ([Start date not specified]) – [Role title not specified] – [Responsibilities not listed]

**EDUCATION HIGHLIGHTS**
*   No education history provided on the profile.

**CERTIFICATIONS**
*   Building Web Applications in PHP (Mar 2020) - Coursera
*   Architecting with Google Compute Engine Specialization (Dec 2019) - Coursera
*   Machine Learning (Oct 2019) - Coursera
*   Google Cloud Platform Fundamentals: Core Infrastructure (Aug 2019) - Coursera
fair, my bad. engineering at avoca... what's the actual story there? what do you build?
We build AI workforce for service based companies in the US

ah, ai workforce for us service companies... so basically replacing entire teams with ai agents. that's the real disruption - not just chatbots but actual digital employees. makes sense why they'd need solid engineering talent.

how long you been working total?
5 years
5 years in the game... solid foundation. what kind of role you looking for next?
Software engineer, engineering manager etc.

software engineer or engineering manager... interesting range. 5 years puts you right at that crossroads where you could go deeper technically or start leading teams.

bangalore or open to remote/other cities?
Bangalore and open to remote
5 years experience + software engineer or engineering manager + bangalore/remote... sound right?
done. i'm spinning things up on my end. you'll start seeing good stuff soon.
Yes

yoooo kartik! welcome to the fam 🔥

you're officially in the tal network now. i've got your profile locked and loaded - 5 years engineering experience, open to both ic and management tracks, bangalore + remote flexibility.

the good stuff starts flowing your way soon. roles that actually match what you're worth, not the usual spam.

time to level up from ai customer support to whatever gets you hyped. let's get you something that pays and doesn't make you question your life choices lmaooo
Hi

AI Engineer at Uplers

Kartik, this AI Engineer role leverages your experience in AI/agentic systems (LangChain), offers remote work, and builds NLQ layers, aligning with your engineering background.

Apply: https://jobs.tal.af/Cjo7K
Hi

hey kartik

just slid that ai engineer role from uplers your way. remote, langchain, nlq layers... basically what you're already doing but maybe with better vibes.

what's making you want to leave avoca anyway?
I want to work in IST hours. I currently work in EST timezone. I also want to join a company that would offer me equity

est to ist hours is a massive quality of life upgrade. plus equity... you're looking for ownership and better work-life balance. that's the real move.

what's your current salary? helps me filter out the lowball offers

75k usd... for 5 years experience in ai engineering? that's low for the market, especially with your background. you should be targeting 100k+ easily, especially with equity.

what's your minimum number you'd accept? and what's your target?
Similar compensation with equity and better working hours

got it. 75k base + equity + ist hours. you're basically looking for a proper upgrade - same money but with ownership and better life.

i'll filter for roles that actually offer equity packages, not just "we might give you options someday" bs.

what's your notice period?
2 weeks

2 weeks notice is clean. makes you flexible for quick moves.

you're all set kartik. i've got your full profile now:

- 5 years engineering experience
- software engineer / engineering manager track
- bangalore + remote
- 75k current, looking for similar + equity
- ist hours (currently est)
- 2 weeks notice

i'm scanning for roles that actually offer equity packages and operate in ist-friendly timezones. no more est midnight calls for you.

anything specific you want me to avoid? certain industries or company stages?
Anything works

anything works... love that energy. you're not picky about industry, just want the right setup.

alright kartik, you're officially locked in. i'll be sliding roles that match your vibe - equity, ist hours, proper engineering culture.

meanwhile... how's the avoca chaos been lately? still dealing with customer complaints through ai or has it gotten interesting?
Salary range in INR can be more than 75 lakhs per annum

75 lakhs INR minimum... that's around 90k USD. solid target for 5 years experience with equity.

updated your profile. now i'm looking for:
- 75 lakhs+ INR base
- equity package
- ist hours
- remote/bangalore
- engineering or management track

you're not settling for less. good.

any particular tech stack preferences or you flexible there too?
Nodejs and python

nodejs and python... classic combo. backend engineering with some ai/ml flavor. that's what most of the good roles want anyway.

you're all set. i'll ping you when something actually fits.

btw... what got you into engineering in the first place? was there a specific moment or just always liked building things?
I liked working with computers

simple as that. liked working with computers. respect.

alright kartik, i'm on it. you'll hear from me when i find something that's actually worth your time.

in the meantime... how's the job search been going on your end? getting any interesting bites or just the usual recruiter spam?
Not actively looking

not actively looking... that's the best position to be in. means you're not desperate, just open to the right opportunity. that's when the best offers come through.

perfect. i'll slide things when they're actually interesting, not just because you need a job.

you're all set. talk soon.

hey, saw this AI Engineer role through Uplers

it's remote and works with langchain/crewai for a california startup

though the shift is 11pm-4am IST... that's rough for work-life balance

another AI Engineer role through Uplers

same setup - remote, langchain/crewai for a california startup

but again the shift is 11pm-4am IST... brutal timing honestly

hey, happy monday - if it’s not, we’ll work together on making it happen soon :)
how’s the week looking? what would you like me to focus on this week with the search?

Senior Full Stack Engineer at SourcingXPress

Senior Full Stack role at Trintech leverages your experience & offers Bangalore location, but clarify salary to ensure it meets your 75L INR minimum.

Apply: https://jobs.tal.af/VAD6i

Remote role at $100k USD aligns with your comp target, offering IST timezone flexibility and AI focus.

Apply: https://jobs.tal.af/Ngk7o

AI Engineer at NavGurukul

IST hours & AI role for social impact aligns with your timezone & ownership goals, but note lower pay than current.

Apply: https://jobs.tal.af/Qv0iS
Don’t send jobs that are lower pay than current

you're right. 75k USD is already low for your experience - anything below that is a step back, not forward.

filtering out anything under 75 lakhs INR / 90k USD from now on. you deserve better, not lateral moves.

the crossover role at 100k USD looks solid though - remote, ist hours, ai focus. that's the kind of upgrade we're looking for.

anything else you want me to filter out besides pay?

That’s it. Renoir is not a compulsion
  Remote *

got it. remote only, no pay below current, renoir not required.

filter updated: remote-first roles only, 75 lakhs INR minimum, no renoir dependency.

that crossover role at 100k USD still fits - remote, ist hours, ai focus, above your current comp.

anything else about the kind of engineering culture you're looking for?
Not remote only

that's even worse - the link not only doesn't work but shows a low-paying job? that's a system issue for sure.

sorry about that. i'll flag it to the team. you shouldn't be seeing jobs below your minimum, especially with broken links.

back to you - what's the real reason you're open to moving from avoca? just the timezone thing or something else?

wait so you're open to hybrid/in-office roles too? not just remote?

that changes things - opens up more bangalore opportunities. good to know.

still keeping the 75 lakhs INR minimum filter though. no pay cuts.

what's your take on the crossover role at 100k USD? remote, ist hours, ai focus... seems like it ticks most boxes
This link does not work. It’s some other random job

damn, that's frustrating. links should work - that's literally the whole point.

let me check what's up with that. sometimes the system glitches or the job gets pulled.

meanwhile, what's your current setup at avoca? fully remote or hybrid? and what's making you want to leave despite not actively looking?
This is a very low paying job mentioned in its description
